note: Dated tax rules (design section 7, researched 11 Oct 2026). Rates exclude surcharge and cess. Decision support, not tax advice. Rows marked Medium or Low are unverified against primary text.

gold_silver_etf.label: Gold and silver ETFs
gold_silver_etf.note: Pre-2025 transfers of lots bought before 1 Apr 2023 and the 2023-2025 deemed short-term window are not modelled: treated with the 12-month rule and flagged

fund_unclassified.label: Mutual fund, tax class not yet known

equity_fund.label: Equity-oriented mutual funds (65% or more in domestic equity), incl. ELSS and index funds

debt_fund.label: Debt, liquid and money-market funds
debt_fund.note: Bought on or after 1 Apr 2023: slab rate at any holding period. Bought earlier: more than 24 months for transfers from 23 Jul 2024 (12.5%); the older 36-month indexed rule for earlier transfers is not modelled and is flagged

hybrid_other.label: Hybrid funds with 35% to 65% in domestic equity
hybrid_other.note: 35% to 65% domestic equity, not a specified fund: 24 months, 12.5%, short-term at slab (checked against an AMC tax reckoner for FY 2025-26, 28 Oct 2026; its table was garbled, so still Medium). Conservative Hybrid funds (more than 65% debt) are taxed as debt_fund.

overseas_fof.label: Overseas and gold fund-of-funds (unlisted)
overseas_fof.note: 24 months inferred from AMC tax reckoners; bought 1 Apr 2023 to 31 Mar 2025 and sold before 1 Apr 2025 may be deemed short-term at any period under the old test: flagged, not modelled
